purpose: Record direct official PEP source checks for the current 12th-series primary mathematics volumes and distinguish confirmed evidence from unresolved volume metadata.
rules: Use only official PEP pages for current-volume confirmation in this pass.
Do not infer a current mathematics rollout schedule from rollout notices for other subjects.
Do not treat legacy digital textbooks as evidence for the 12th-series unit sequence.
A synchronized companion resource can corroborate that a current volume/resource exists, but it does not replace the textbook table of contents unless the unit structure is directly exposed.

confirmed.claim: The PEP 12th series was revised against the 2022 compulsory-education curriculum plan and standards and began formal use in starting grades from autumn 2024.
The new PEP primary mathematics series uses units, sections and knowledge points, and each volume ends with a '复习与关联' unit.
Grade 1 upper places '5以内数的认识和加、减法' and '6～10的认识和加、减法' as consecutive units.
The revised series merges the former '万以内的加减法（一）/（二）' units, merges '两位数乘两位数' with '三位数乘两位数', and merges two upper-primary '图形的位置' blocks.
PEP published a Grade 1 upper '同步口算练习册' in September 2024 and states that it is synchronized by lesson period with the new textbook.
confirmed.use_limit: Confirms a current Grade 1 upper synchronized companion resource; the page does not expose the unit table of contents or textbook ISBN.

confirmed_fields: two current unit titles and their consecutive relationship

current_volume_findings.note: Official PEP search currently surfaces a legacy digital textbook and legacy companion materials. These must not be treated as current 12th-series sequence evidence.

search_result_limitations: The official PEP product and training pages indexed by public search do not currently expose complete 12th-series primary mathematics TOCs for all 12 semester volumes.

Legacy PEP digital books remain useful for historical comparison only.
